cx2_truthful.basis: Strand’s answers match the register and Grell’s statement: each presented one credential, and both worked and left together. Camera counts and badge logs corroborate their presence. Grell remained certified; an administrative backlog explains his disabled vault access. The supervisor explains the late tape pull. The records resolve the apparent single-person entry and close the main gaps.

cx2_deceptive.basis: The single-person doorway events, Strand’s corridor access, Grell’s confirmed absence, and missing spare-card registration establish Strand’s involvement in the unaccompanied vault entry. He acknowledges working alone and returning SP-3 but leaves unanswered why it was released and who presented the two credentials, concealing how the entry was accomplished.

cx3.basis: rec-05 explains the late tape pull and confirms collection, but does not establish who presented each credential or stayed inside TV-1. The PIN-based attribution does not prove single-person entry. Strand describes a permitted spare-card arrangement, but the examined records neither verify that account nor establish involvement his answers conceal.
